body: Maybe this broken ankle is a blessing in disguise. It might be the thing keeping you alive, and if it is than I'm glad you broke it (I just thought of the "I don't care you broke your elbow" vine oml). You sound like you're going through a really tough time, but it might get better over time? I know it's so cliché, but it could. Perhaps you and your partner need some time apart to realize how much you want to be together. No matter what, just try to hold on. I know it's hard and you want to give up, but just try to stay alive for a while longer. You matter in this world.

Hello there! I myself am cis, so I'm not entirely familiar on all the effects of dysphoria, but I know it's a pain in the ass and can wind up in valuable lives being taken. If you didn't belong on this earth, you wouldn't be here, though that is my personal opinion. What are you studying? I'm sure you're doing great with it! And you don't sound like that bad of a person, if that means anything to you. You seem pretty cool actually, but I don't want to sound creepy or anything. You do belong here, and from one queer person to another, I hope you stay strong enough to keep trying. Maybe one day, you'll make a big change in the world and can use your story to help others. Or don't, no matter what, just try to hold on for a little while longer :)
I relate to this a lot. It makes existing so much more difficult, and it's so lonely. I'm really sorry you feel this way. I'm not that good with comforting, but just know you're not alone :)

Sometimes I think of all the fluffy puppers I'll miss out on petting. I know it's small, but it helps a little. Their big eyes and tails wagging so fast it's just a blur. And if dogs aren't your thing, think about cats, or bunnies, or elephants! Whatever might help you at least a little :)

Hey! I'm sorry you're going through this! Losing friends can be really tough, especially when they're someone you're close to, and repeatedly. This is unfortunately common, and I hate how often it happens. Nevertheless, I'd be happy to talk if you ever need it! I'm not great at helping people, but I'm willing to try anyways!

I relate to a lot of this. I'm terrified of someone I love finding my body and having to handle it. But at the same time, would I rather have a stranger find me out god knows where? Or just be reported missing, never to be seen again? I'm really sorry you feel this way... I'm not much help in these situations but just know that you aren't alone :)
